# Original mixed skeletal-label vectors

The nine CDXML sources, expected facts and scripts are original Bondline test data,
dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. No reference application, proprietary export, binary,
font, icon or template was used. The
[contract](../../../../../docs/research/mixed-skeletal-labels.md) separates public format
facts from original checked C4/mandatory-label and placement policies.

The independent reviewer froze these files in the main worktree's ignored
`target/mixed-labels/independent/` before IO producer changes, on basef16b79f/contractb30f0d6.
The subsequent5f58276 metadata clarification keeps hidden carbons neutral, natural-isotope
and nonradical. `mixed-vectors.json` pins every exact source byte count/SHA256 and distinct
source/application IDs; do not regenerate references to fit product output.

Original FontTools4.61.1 BoundsPen/hmtx/GPOS measures the explicit labels using existing
Apache Roboto SHA256
`56a45233d29f11b4dfb86d248e921939d115778f87325e7ae8cc108383d6664d`. Expat/Decimal performs
only declared lexical edits and reads exact numeric fields, child presence, styles,
resources and active/dormant flags. Constructed no-implicit-H and direct unsanitized
RDKit2026.09.2 independently consume the actual sources. C3H9NO/C3H10N2 are literal
original input formulas, not evidence of general valence or reference execution.
The shared hidden-carbon classifier remains independent production code under test;
these Python sources never import Bondline output or its parser/render implementation.

The IO lane reproduced all nine source bytes/manifest and the unchanged facts/checks
before production. External checking passes9 sources,16 explicit-label FontTools boxes
and11 strict-reader refusal controls. `mandatory_collinear` and `methanol_bad_c2` are
intentional model/source negatives. Dormant flag absent/yes/no are deliberate data.
No image or human-approved golden is included.

Generator/checker copies have path-routing-only adaptations: discover the repository
from the tracked fixture location, preserve literal `BONDLINE_PYTHON`, and default generated
results to ignored `target/mixed-labels/independent/`. `BONDLINE_ORACLE_OUTPUT` routes a
worktree reproduction to its existing parent evidence folder. Mathematical methods,
values, reader bytes and frozen data are unchanged. With pinned tools installed:

```sh
python3 -B crates/io/tests/fixtures/mixed-labels/check_mixed.py
```

The checker reads these tracked sources and writes fresh facts/checks only to the ignored
output folder. `generate_mixed.py` is original provenance/reproducibility tooling; it never
automatically updates tracked expectations. Its ignored metadata reproduction reuses the
canonical `crates/cli/tests/support/connected-label-old48.json`; no duplicate is bundled.
